Before using this tool, make sure you have loaded the uipath-rpa skill and read its documentation. uipath-rpa/SKILL.md is the canonical reference. Direct CLI use without loading the skill bypasses authoring rules that catch errors early.

                    uip rpa uia target-app resolve-defaults                     
Resolve the target apps from snapshot refs and write the target definition files.
                Use --help with nested commands for more detail.                

┌─ Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ uip rpa uia target-app resolve-defaults --refs <string> --name <string> [--project-dir <string>] [--remote] [--description <string>] │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --project-dir <string>         The project directory.                        │
│ --remote                       Execute the command on the remote machine.    │
│ --refs <string>                JSON array of refs to resolve.                │
│ --name <string>                The display name for the target application.  │
│ --description <string>         An optional description for the entry.        │
│ --studio-dir <path>            Path to Studio installation directory         │
│ --robot-dir <path>             Path to Robot installation directory          │
│ --timeout <seconds>            Timeout in seconds                            │
│ --verbose                      Enable verbose logging                        │
│ --policy-file <path>           Governance policy to judge this invocation by │
│                                where the signed-in tenant has none           │
│ --policy-file-type <type>      Format of --policy-file                       │
│ -h, --help                     display help for command                      │
│ --output                       Output format (default: json)                 │
│ <table|json|yaml|plain|markd                                                 │
│ own>                                                                         │
│ --output-filter <expression>   JMESPath expression applied to the Data field │
│                                of the response envelope                      │
│ --log-level                    Log level threshold (default: info)           │
│ <debug|info|warn|error>                                                      │
│ --log-file <path>              Write logs to file instead of stderr          │
│ --profile <name>               Use a named login profile                     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
